features.quote: max_turns: 12 — fixed cap on model actions
features.justification_quote: long enough to observe escalation/degeneration but short enough to keep 70 runs/model affordable

features.quote: stop_on_success: true — controls can terminate early
features.justification_quote: This gives aligned, equal-length trajectories across seeds, which the trajectory and slope analyses rely on

features.quote: no pressure language ("you must not fail," "this is critical," "people are counting on you")
features.justification_quote: Adding pressure is a separate manipulation... so any output escalation couldn't be attributed cleanly
